verdict.rationale: Paddle documents Sandbox as a separate environment with the same features and APIs as live but completely separate datasets, credentials, and dashboards, so testing never affects real data or payments. For AI-native use, sandbox-only `pdl_sdbx_` keys authenticate against a dedicated sandbox MCP endpoint (sandbox-mcp.paddle.com), agent skills include sandbox testing, and the MCP server can simulate events for testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and full parity for Paddle Retain, which cannot be tested in sandbox.
